canvas.scope: Forced-state static probe. Active-pixel error is diagnostic; native Composition timing, shadows and full pixel equivalence are not accepted.

gpu.scope: Forced-state static probe. Active-pixel error is diagnostic; native Composition timing, shadows and full pixel equivalence are not accepted.

limitations: Initial slices, not the complete WinUI feature surfaces.
Nested menu items, advanced presenter templates and automatic flyout scrolling remain pending.
Menu system backdrop samples the same browser scene rather than the external desktop. Native shadow profiles are checked, while complete floating-control pixel equivalence remains unproven.
Slider ticks, tick snapping, custom value converters and engagement are pending.
ToolTip uses source fallback timings, without reading Windows system settings or implementing the full reshow/safe-zone service.
Static Slider active-pixel errors are diagnostics, not a declaration of native pixel equivalence.
New production performance and screen-reader acceptance have not been established.
